      • writeMessage

        public void writeMessage​(java.lang.String msg)
                  throws java.io.IOException
        Writes the passed message to the socket output.
        Parameters:
        msg - : the message to be sent.
        Throws:
        java.io.IOException - Signals that an I/O exception has occurred. Generally indicates that socket has disconnected.
        Requires
        msg != null, out != null.

      • awaitMessage

        public java.lang.String awaitMessage()
                              throws java.io.IOException
        Awaits single line from the socket input and returns it. This method may block while waiting for input from the socket.
        Returns:
        a String containing one line of a message from the socket input.
        Throws:
        java.io.IOException - Signals that an I/O exception has occurred. Generally indicates that socket has disconnected.
        Requires
        in != null.

      • moveIntToString

        public java.lang.String moveIntToString​(int[] move)
        Converts the passed Integer array to a single String to use in the MOVE protocol.
        Parameters:
        move - : an Integer array adhering to the move format defined in Board.Move.move
        Returns:
        a String containing the move with each move being separated by a Communications.DELIM, as per the MOVE protocol.
        Requires
        move != null.

      • moveStringToInt

        public int[] moveStringToInt​(java.lang.String[] move)
        Converts the passed move String array containing the full MOVE protocol message into an Integer array containing said move.
        Parameters:
        move - : a String containing the move with each move being separated by a Communications.DELIM, as per the MOVE protocol.
        Returns:
        an Integer array adhering to the move format defined in Board.Move.move
        Requires
        move != null.

      • toCommunicationString

        public static java.lang.String toCommunicationString​(Board board)
        Converts the grid of the passed Board to a form usable for the NEWGAME protocol sent by the server.
        Parameters:
        board - : the board from which to read the grid.
        Returns:
        a String containing all of the grids of the passed board, per the NEWGAME protocol.
